text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Number one, number one! First place, and 
most popular too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I'll prove in this Arima Kinen that I can 
become that kind of Umamusume! Now, off to 
the paddock!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Scarlett's already entering the paddock? 
She's really fired up...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: He really can see it. But I...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... How should I put this? In other 
words—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's like "the shape of a dream."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is it really okay for me to stay 
like this?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Going head-to-head with Scarlet is 
definitely as fun as it gets.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll train to beat her, boost my speed and 
stamina, and throw everything I have at 
her!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"There's nothing I'm lacking. There 
shouldn't be anything. And yet..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Is this way of living truly 'cool'? Is it 
really what I'm aiming for?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I'm just an ordinary star 
Umamusume. Am I really turning into 
something that's just... amazingly normal?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's fine for Scarlett. That's what 
she's aiming for. But...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I started thinking... maybe I'm just not 
cut out for this? That's what crossed my 
mind..."

To become the coolest version of herself, 
Vodka dove headfirst into the Twinkle 
Series.

The weak are certainly uncool. But whether 
being strong unconditionally makes someone 
cool, I just don't know.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What do you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Let's think about it once the Arima Kinen 
is over.

Let's think about it after the Arima 
Kinen, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Once it's over, huh? I see... Yeah, you're 
right...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ain't no point mopin' around right before 
the big year-end showdown.
choice_data_list: At least that's pretty uncool, huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, you bet! Arima is the culmination 
of the entire year, after all."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"For better or worse, I'll give it 
everything I've got! No regrets once I've 
burned myself out completely!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm heading out. I'll definitely 
find the answer!
